description: Processes and transforms JSON using jq expressions. Accepts JSON from a file path or inline string. Returns the transformed result.

arg.description: Named string variables for parameterized expressions (maps to repeated --arg NAME VALUE)

argjson.description: Named JSON variables for parameterized expressions (maps to repeated --argjson NAME VALUE)

exitStatus.description: Use jq exit status for boolean checks: exit 1 if last output is false/null (--exit-status)

file.description: Path to a JSON file to process

input.description: Inline JSON string to process (used when file is not provided)

nullInput.description: Don't read any input, useful for generating JSON from scratch (--null-input)

rawInput.description: Read each line as a string instead of JSON (--raw-input)

rawOutput.description: Output raw strings without JSON quotes (-r flag)

slurp.description: Read entire input into a single array, useful for JSONL or multiple objects (--slurp)

name: jq
title: JSON Processor
